Riverpark Ride

Chattanooga, TN · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

Riverpark Ride is a road and social group ride in Chattanooga, TN. It rolls every Friday at 9:00 am from Hubert Fry Station, Tennessee Riverpark. About 20 miles, 11 mph average. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @chattanoogabicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Riverpark Ride group ride

A slow ride along the Riverwalk from Hubert Fry to St. Elmo and back, away from traffic. About 20 miles at 11 mph with a restroom stop and a longer snack break. The club calendar shows it resuming October 16, 2026.
